sources.title: Release Notes for Omada Software Controller V6.1.0
Omada Cloud SDN Platform Compatibility List
sources.role: authoritative model-support lookup referenced by release notes

rules: Same first three controller version digits do not imply feature parity across platforms.
A controller can manage only devices running supported firmware; confirm exact device/controller compatibility before adoption, provisioning, upgrade or feature compilation.
Feature availability is a separate gate from basic device support.
When release notes mark a feature as requiring device firmware upgrade, controller version alone is insufficient authorization.
Omada app compatibility is not equivalent to controller-device compatibility.
Unknown compatibility is NOT_SUPPORTED_UNVERIFIED, never assumed supported.

v6_1_evidence.platform_difference_example: Release notes state Linux Controller supports Cluster Mode while Windows Controller did not yet support it at that release.

upgrade_gate.special_note: Software Controller release notes state that since 5.14.32, upgrading from Controller v4 is no longer supported.

pass_requires: required feature available for that tuple
